extract_post_relax_config: extract post-relaxation filtering parameters like energy cutoff and density tolerance from a workflow config dictionary
filter_single_dataset: filter and deduplicate crystal structures in a single parquet dataset by energy, density, and connectivity
filter_multiple_datasets: submit parallel SLURM jobs to filter and deduplicate multiple crystal structure datasets across directories
review_filtering_workflow: review the post-relaxation filtering workflow that validates connectivity, applies density and energy cutoffs, and deduplicates structures
refactor_deduplication_params: refactor the filter and deduplicate function to use custom lattice, site, and angle tolerance parameters for structure matching
